args.lesson: Scanned 65 tender-stage OCDS releases (updated 2026-11-03..12) via 2 successful FETCHes; a 2-week window at limit=100 was refused by the host fetch size limit, so keep windows to about 1 week and limit<=60. Of 7 software/IT CPV matches only 2 have deadlines after 2026-12-14, and one (105838-2026 Luton) is already listed. One genuinely new candidate: 106518-2026 South Ayrshire Council leisure management system, open procedure, deadline 2026-12-18T12:00Z, no advertised value, submission via Public Contracts Scotland. Continuity after Dec 7 is thin: software tenders with far deadlines are rare in a 10-day window, so a refresh cadence of weekly scans is needed to keep the page at 2+ live notices. Portals, tender packs and eligibility unread; demand still unknown.
